description: Provider-scoped tool suite for the Master Brain. Northstar runs two lanes: LOCAL (the operator's machine, free, private, never commercially redistributed) and CLOUD (paid, customer-facing, commercially licensed). Shared/model-suite.json answers 'which model for this tier'; this file answers 'which tools may the brain touch at all on this lane'. Northstar_backend/provider_suite.py loads this and fails closed on anything unknown.

policy.rationale: The local lane is the operator's private bench: non-commercial weights (FLUX.1 [dev], unverified LoRA weights) and copyleft agent runtimes are fine there because nothing is resold. The cloud lane is a commercial product: every tool that runs there must carry a licence that permits commercial network use, and must be individually armed.

local.display: Local engine (Ollama + ComfyUI on the operator machine)
local.note: Non-commercial weights are permitted here. Nothing produced on this lane is resold as a hosted service.

cloud.note: Customer-facing commercial lane. Only commercially licensed tools; each provider is separately armed and metered.

comfyui.name: ComfyUI graph engine
comfyui.unlocks: Local image/video generation, inpaint, cutout, edit, upscale graphs.
comfyui.notes: GPL-3.0 permits commercial use; it constrains redistribution, not output. Runs as a separate local process so no linking obligation reaches Northstar code.

flux2_klein.name: FLUX.2 Klein (9B, GGUF)
flux2_klein.unlocks: Local clean-plate product renders and mockup plates.
flux2_klein.notes: Already the Design Studio default (STUDIO_IMAGE_MODEL). Apache-2.0, so it is also cloud-eligible, but it is only wired locally today.

qwen_image_edit.name: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 (Q4_K_M)
qwen_image_edit.unlocks: Text-faithful edit/refine of a real image under the OCR drift gate.
qwen_image_edit.notes: The text-fidelity gate (text_fidelity.verify_edit_preserves_copy) blocks any edit that rewrites the label copy.

birefnet.name: BiRefNet cutout
birefnet.notes: MASK marks the background in this build; the graph inverts it before alpha.

wan22_ti2v.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B (Q5_K_M)
wan22_ti2v.unlocks: Free local product motion clips — the zero-cost alternative to fal video.
wan22_ti2v.notes: Local video is slow and short-form; it is the fallback, never a silent substitute for a paid hero render.

flux1_dev.name: FLUX.1 [dev]
flux1_dev.unlocks: Strong local base model for experiments and internal concepts.
flux1_dev.notes: The canonical example of the local-only lane: a genuinely capable model whose licence forbids commercial output. Allowed locally, blocked for any customer-facing render.

ultratex.name: UltraTex 2K multi-view 3D texturing
ultratex.unlocks: Untextured mesh + one reference image -> six 2048px texture views baked to a UV-mapped GLB. Turns product meshes into textured 3D props for mockups and motion.
ultratex.notes: INSTALLED + LIVE 2026-10-21: full pipeline verified end-to-end in 200 s (prep, 25-step sampler, 2048 bake) producing a valid 10.3 MB GLB + albedo PNG on the RTX 5080 Laptop 16 GB. Runner detail: the example workflow expects flux-2-klein-base-9b-fp8.safetensors; this box uses the GGUF Q6_K base through UnetLoaderGGUF (base fp8 is gated on HF and 16.9 GB bf16 would not fit), PEFT LoRA applies cleanly over GGUF. xatlas failed to build on Python 3.14 and is NOT needed because uv_mode=comfy_gpu works. LICENCE NOW CONFIRMED: the published weight mirror ships FLUX-NON-COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md, so the weights inherit FLUX's non-commercial terms - local bench only, never a customer render.

openmontage.name: OpenMontage agentic video harness
openmontage.unlocks: Pipelines + tools + stage-director skills for explainers, cinematic trailers, talking heads, documentary montage from free/open archives, clip factory, localization. Zero-key path uses Piper TTS, Remotion/HyperFrames, FFmpeg and Archive.org/NASA/Wikimedia footage.
openmontage.notes: INSTALLED + LIVE 2026-10-21: cloned outside the repo (never vendored), Python 3.11 venv, core deps + piper-tts 1.8.0 + faster-whisper 1.2.1 + 199 npm packages. Registry discovers 138 tools / 38 available without any API key (96 need paid provider keys) and rendered the zero-key 'world-in-numbers' demo to a real 690-frame MP4. Two separate facts, both true: (1) AGPL-3.0 does allow commercial use, but section 13's network clause is a legal question we have not answered, so it is local-only by default; (2) it is a harness, not a model - most of its 60+ provider integrations are paid cloud APIs, so 'local lane' means 'installed on this machine', not 'no network'.

piper_tts.name: Piper TTS
piper_tts.unlocks: Offline narration for local video and voiceover drafts.
piper_tts.notes: piper-tts 1.8.0 + onnxruntime 1.31.0 installed in the OpenMontage venv (Python 3.11); the CLI needs a voice .onnx per call, fetched on demand into --data-dir. The zero-cost voice lane; it never leaves the machine.

sapi_voice.name: Northstar local voice service (Windows SAPI)
sapi_voice.unlocks: Always-available local speech for previews and accessibility reads.
sapi_voice.notes: tools/local_voice_service.py serves the SPA on :8321; Northstar_backend/local_voice.py is the same engine used in-process by the pipeline. WIRED 2026-10-22: studio_generation.generate_video(narration=...) speaks the script and muxes it onto the clip with ffmpeg (-shortest), so narrated product video needs no provider key. Verified live: 138,694-byte WAV, 22.05 kHz mono PCM, and a narrated MP4 carrying h264 video + AAC audio. Quality is below ElevenLabs; it exists so a voice path works with zero keys.

faster_whisper.name: faster-whisper
faster_whisper.unlocks: Local transcription for reference-video teardowns and clip selection.
faster_whisper.notes: faster-whisper 1.2.1 installed in the OpenMontage venv; it flipped OpenMontage's 'transcriber' tool from unavailable to available (37 -> 38 zero-key tools). Model weights download on first use. Needed if we adopt the reference-video path without sending audio to a cloud STT API.

rapidocr.name: RapidOCR (onnxruntime)
rapidocr.unlocks: The text-fidelity gate: proves a render or edit did not rewrite label copy.
rapidocr.notes: Already load-bearing in text_fidelity.py; it is the reason 'never let the model draw text' is enforced rather than aspirational.

chromeconnect.name: Chrome Connect browser controller
chromeconnect.unlocks: Headed, read-only browser reads under an operator-owned allowlist.
chromeconnect.notes: Guardrails are operator-owned (config/chromecontrol_policy_owner.json). Never enter credentials, never solve a CAPTCHA.

blender.name: Blender headless render
blender.unlocks: Physics/geometry animation and 3D showcase renders that UltraTex-textured meshes plug into.
blender.notes: OpenMontage's 3D showcase path uses Blender Eevee/Cycles; installing Blender is what closes that loop locally.

openrouter_text.name: OpenRouter DeepSeek lane
openrouter_text.unlocks: T1/T2/T3 reasoning tiers on the customer lane.
openrouter_text.notes: Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY presence AND CLOUD_MODEL_LIVE=1. Absence of either is reported, never papered over with a local fallback.

fal_image_video.name: fal.ai image + video
fal_image_video.unlocks: Hero video (Veo/Kling/Wan) and FLUX.2 pro stills for customer deliverables.
fal_image_video.notes: Per-call cost is recorded from the provider's returned usage, not from the planning table.

replicate_edit.name: Replicate FLUX.2 pro edit
replicate_edit.unlocks: Optional fallback edit lane when fal is degraded.
replicate_edit.notes: Secondary lane only; the router does not silently swap providers.

elevenlabs_tts.name: ElevenLabs v3 voice
elevenlabs_tts.notes: The paid counterpart to Piper; the local lane keeps working when this is unarmed.
